concerns.concern: Change classification and tier evaluation with non-configurable floors
concerns.why: kindOf/classify/evaluate decide how many humans must review; a wrong kind rule, inert filter or floor silently lowers the required review.

concerns.concern: Policy schema, default areas/rules and validatePolicy layering
concerns.why: Default globs and the replace-vs-merge semantics (empty list deletes an area, rules replace the list) determine which paths are treated as sensitive.

concerns.concern: Review carries classification and verdict, recomputed after model ranking
concerns.why: The verdict must be recomputed from the model-ranked change set or the shown tier goes stale against raised attention.
Layering changes which values win (base rank/dispatch/prompt carried over) and the CLI swallows repoRoot failures, so a repo policy could be silently skipped.

concerns.concern: Config accepts areas and policy keys via validatePolicy
concerns.why: New top-level keys widen what config accepts and policy errors must still surface as ConfigError naming the key.

concerns.concern: Policy tests and dispatch test fixtures updated for new shapes
concerns.why: Tests pin the tier table, schema errors and layering; dispatch fixtures must build Review/Config with the new required fields.

concerns.concern: Read-only tier survey script over recent commits
concerns.why: Data-check script only; risk is limited to running git read-only in the target repo.
